description: This file defines the JobCategoryService class within the OrangeHRM system, providing methods for managing job categories such as retrieval, saving, deleting, and normalization. It interfaces with a data access object (JobCategoryDao) and utilizes traits for normalization functionality.

classes.name: JobCategoryService
classes.description: Service class providing CRUD operations and normalization for job categories within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getJobCategoryDao
methods.description: Returns the current JobCategoryDao instance used by this service.

methods.name: setJobCategoryDao
methods.description: Sets the JobCategoryDao instance for this service.

methods.name: getJobCategoryList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of job categories with optional sorting, pagination, and counting options.

methods.name: getJobCategoryById
methods.description: Fetches a specific job category by its ID.

methods.name: saveJobCategory
methods.description: Saves a JobCategory entity to the database.

methods.name: deleteJobCategory
methods.description: Deletes job categories given their IDs.

methods.name: getJobCategoryArray
methods.description: Returns an array of normalized job category data.
